basics.label: Senior NodeJS Engineer · Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, SNS) · AWS · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.senior-nodejs: Senior NodeJS Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Node.js, distributed backend systems, event-driven architecture (Kafka, SNS), and cloud-native AWS deployments. Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas at Turbot HQ, cutting policy-code duplication ~60% while keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 end-of-life.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services (SecurityHub, CloudWatch, ControlTower, Shield, Comprehend, Pinpoint, RAM, X-Ray, EC2, EFS) in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and resource-cleanup workflows; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via templating, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL and unblocking the Node.js runtime upgrade.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for debugging.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal distributed microservices.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, an observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures at scale.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, automated Slack release notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging, improving deployment automation and system resilience.
